full_wiring_candidate.added_interface: FC PC4 emergency-stop button and PB6/PB7 internal pullups on the 5-MCU circuit

limitations: Motor controller Hall lock and flight-controller command markers do not demonstrate body movement, takeoff, hover or recovery.
The controller status on these source/diagram revisions does not establish physical 4in1 AT32F421 ESC or RP2354B FC equivalence.
The five-controller run did not assert body position, velocity, quaternion, measured IMU, battery sag, thermal, real gate-driver current or six-DOF closed-loop response.
Separate simulated driver-fault campaign is needed; do not infer actuator fault safety from startup-only requirements.
The native six-layer physical PCB is not electrically equivalent to the STM32L476 model plant, and no physical flight is accepted.
